Hidden Gem: Pho Coi
Jan 2025 • Couples
We stumbled upon Pho Coi by accident, and what a find! The place looked clean and inviting, so we decided to give it a try—and we’re so glad we did.

The food was absolutely fabulous and incredibly affordable. The spring rolls, beef and noodles, and fried tofu were all packed with flavor and cooked to perfection. Paired with a couple of beers, the whole meal came to under 300,000 dong—a steal for such quality food!

If you’re looking for delicious, budget-friendly eats in Hanoi, Pho Coi is definitely worth checking out. We’ll be back for sure!
